# PaddleOCR model license

`LICENSE` is the unchanged Apache-2.0 license from
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/blob/main/LICENSE, retrieved
2026-10-18. SHA-256:
`3840c5c0c61c294264d2dd77b8777be6ddd90121ef4e0e64abcd22edea581d6e`.

The optional PP-OCRv6 models/configuration and original model cards are
revision/hash pinned in `scripts/uct/pins.json`. They stay outside Git under
LocalAppData. Preparation retains this license and model cards. CPU/runtime
and external TensorRT SDK terms remain separate; see
`docs/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`.
